title: Primary Care Provider Assignment: Single Specialist Referrals
content:
**Desk system reference — single specialist referrals under the Primary Care Provider Assignment.**

### Policy

A single specialist referral is issued by the member's active assignment to one named in-network specialist, and it records the number of visits the referral covers during its validity.

| Point | Position |
|---|---|
| Issued from | The member's active Primary Care Provider Assignment |
| Issued to | One named in-network specialist |
| What it records | The number of visits the referral covers during its validity |
| Where it appears | The active assignment's referral history, as a single referral dated on the day it is issued |

### System entry: `issue_specialist_referral_96d4855f`

**Capability.** Issues a single specialist referral on a member's active primary care assignment, sending the member to one named in-network specialist. One call adds one single-type referral entry, dated today and given a new referral number, to the assignment's referral history, naming the specialist and the number of visits the referral covers. Nothing else on the member's record changes; the member and the specialist's office can quote the new referral number from the receipt.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the representative unlocks `issue_specialist_referral_96d4855f` with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters**

- `pcp_assignment_id` — reference number of the member's active primary care assignment the referral is written on, as it appears on the member's primary care assignment record.
- `specialist_npi` — NPI of the specialist the referral names, written as the 10-digit NPI with digits only and no spaces or punctuation.
- `referral_visits` — the number of specialist visits the referral covers, a whole non-negative number of visits with no decimals.

**Return.** A receipt with `status` (the text "issued" when the referral was recorded), `pcp_event_id` (reference of the new referral history entry), `referral_number` (the new referral number in the form RF-YYMM-NNNNN), `referral_type` (always "single"), `specialist_npi` (10-digit NPI), `issue_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `referral_visits` (integer visits recorded). A receipt with status "issued" means the referral is in force on the assignment.

**Illustration (hypothetical values).** A call naming an active assignment, NPI 1234567893 and 4 visits returns status "issued", referral type "single", a new RF-YYMM-NNNNN number, today's date as the issue date and 4 visits.
